data: This course is designed as an analytical, contextualised introduction to Indian foreign policy and strategic thinking. The course is designed to enable students to follow contemporary debates in an informed and critical way, and from multiple points of view. Traditionally, this topic is taught through a historical approach and an overview of bilateral relationships. This course will merge that with elements from foreign policy analysis courses, that is, by including themes such as the influence of domestic politics and non-political issues. It will begin with a contextualising historical overview and then briefly examine contributing factors that shape thinking and policy on India’s external relations before looking specifically at key relationships and important policy areas.
